comment: Every one of the ten knobs has its own attenuverter and CV jack directly below it, so the ten attenuverters share one line. The diffuser is three stages of four-deep nested allpass, twenty-four fractional delay lines in all, whose lengths are prime numbers indexed by size times a scale; the index glides with a 0.23 second one-pole so sweeping size slides rather than steps. The diffusion coefficient alternates sign across the three stages, which is where the reversed-sounding build-up at medium settings comes from. The channel rotator, hardcoded to a quarter turn in the original, is the spin knob here. The damping is sample-rate compensated, which the original's raw coefficient is not. configBypass passes each input to its own output. The panel prints caligo, time, size, diff, feedback, damp, mod, rate, mix, spin, drift, frz, sct, in L, in R, clk, frz, sct, snd L, snd R, rtn L, rtn R, l and r.
